summary: Reproduced both candidate counterexamples, preserved its valid mixed-dtype fixes, routed MIS through the dtype-safe convolution boundary, and prevented PAD_SLOT_ID=-1 from gathering or updating conv_states[-1].

tests.what_was_measured: On gfx950, confirmed the MIS production method directly used causal_conv1d_fn; BF16 activation with FP32 and FP16 caches each produced Triton new_conv_state branch-type CompilationError, and the candidate helper changed the PAD_SLOT_ID=-1 cache row while the direct same-dtype kernel preserved it.

On gfx950, BF16 activation with FP32 and FP16 cache storage compiled and matched independent grouped-conv output and active final-state references; PAD_SLOT_ID=-1 cache storage remained exactly unchanged; source inspection confirmed MIS uses the corrected helper.
The preserved candidate GPU regression passed all four activation/cache dtype combinations against its independent grouped-convolution reference.
19 focused tests and 27 subtests passed, including the new padded-slot boundary test.
Existing GPU causal-convolution regression passed (1 passed, 245 deselected).

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 ran the failing-before compiler/skip-contract reproduction and passing-after numerical checks with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015.

remaining_limitations: QuantTrio/Qwen3.6-27B-AWQ weights were unavailable, so full-model serving and semantic accuracy were not tested.
The available GPU was AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, not the reported RTX 5090/SM120 with CUDA 13.3.
No native source changed, so native rebuild was not applicable.
